blocks.text: When the truth was un-written, its pages scattered everywhere — so the whole world is a hunting ground. Zones are built from **biomes**, each with its own look, ground, and the monster families that settled there.

items: **Corrupted** — where the un-writing bit deepest; the most twisted pages gather here.

blocks.text: Each biome carries a **themed set of monsters**, grouped by difficulty tier, so a zone's danger and its inhabitants match its biome automatically.

text: *Status: the biome framework is in place. The specific map list, layouts, and named zones are still being built.*
